@echo off
chcp 65001 >nul
title Reality Hop: add key to router
echo Type the router admin password (the one for the GL.iNet web panel) and press Enter.
echo Nothing shows while you type. Reality Hop never sees it.
echo.
"<ssh>" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=known_hosts root@192.168.8.1 "mkdir -p /etc/dropbear; touch /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys; grep -q AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIHk /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys || echo ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIHk realityhop >> /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys; chmod 600 /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys; echo; echo Key added. Close this window."
echo.
pause

@echo off
chcp 65001 >nul
title Reality Hop: add key to router
echo Type the router admin password (the one for the GL.iNet web panel) and press Enter.
echo Nothing shows while you type. Reality Hop never sees it.
echo.
"<ssh>" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=known_hosts root@router.lan "mkdir -p /etc/dropbear; touch /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys; grep -q AAAA%B /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys || echo ssh-ed25519 AAAA%B realityhop >> /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys; chmod 600 /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys; echo; echo Key added. Close this window."
echo.
pause
